name: Dong Van
kicker: Stone old quarter on the loop
summary: Stone old quarter in Đồng Văn: walk the market houses and stay the night before the pass. About 40 houses date to 1890, with the market and the houses together. Sunday is the market day. Arrive before sunset and give the quarter its own hour.
getThere: On QL4C through Sà Phìn, before the pass
heroCaption: The square in Đồng Văn, tiled roofs against the karst cliff
body: Walk the old quarter. About 40 houses date to 1890, and the market sits with them. Sunday is the market day in Đồng Văn and in Mèo Vạc. Use the market at night or early in the morning.

Stay the night on these streets and leave the pass for its own morning. Mèo Vạc is 24 km farther and takes most of a morning if you stop. Đồn Cao is a 20-minute hike up from town for the view. Take that walk in daylight.

figures.caption: Market halls in the old quarter, stone columns and tiled roofs
figures.alt: Stone market halls and tiled roofs along the old quarter street in Dong Van

gettingThere: Đồng Văn is the stone town on QL4C, after Yên Minh and Sà Phìn. Xã Đồng Văn is the 2025 commune. Older pages still say the town. The walk is the old quarter.
The palace sits on the Sà Phìn stretch, about 14 km from Đồng Văn town and about 15 km from the center of xã Đồng Văn. Arrive before sunset. Sunday fills the market.

legs.body: QL4C through Yên Minh and Sà Phìn. Sà Phìn is the food and fuel stop. Stay in Đồng Văn. Ride in daylight.
